about: The Ark is explained as the altar of the church: the table is the tomb, the prosphora the body of Christ, and the crowning bread a likeness of the stone the Jews sealed upon the tomb. The chapter then turns on the Jews and idolaters, citing Isaiah 44 and Psalm 96.

sentences.l: The-ark indeed (is) horns-of altar, it, where they-sacrifice holy priests, and-which they-set upon-it table, likeness-of where was-buried in-midst-of Golgotha tomb;
sentences.i: As for the Ark, it is the horns of the altar, where the holy priests offer sacrifice; and what they set on it is a table, a likeness of the place where He was buried, in the midst of Golgotha, the tomb;
sentences.n: ታቦትሰ: the enclitic -ሰ marks a contrast or topic ('as for the Ark'). ውእቱ 'it is' is the copula. ኀበ 'where' + ይሠውዑ 3mp imperfect 'they sacrifice' (root ሠ-ወ-ዐ). ወዘያነብሩ 'and what they set' (ወ + ዘ + 3mp imperfect of the causative አንበረ), with ዲቤሁ 'upon it' resuming the relative; ጠረጲዛ 'table' is the predicate. አምሳለ is a construct ('likeness of') governing the clause ኀበ ተቀብረ, a pattern for reading the church altar as a copy of a sacred place. ተቀብረ is the passive/reflexive (Gt) 'was buried'. The table is thus presented as a likeness of the tomb in which Christ was buried (cf. Matthew 27:60); the Ark/altar is read through the burial.

sentences.i: and what is above the table is the prosphora, a likeness of the apurge (?), which is the body of Emmanuel, unmixed (?) and pure, without fault (?), which our Saviour took from Mary;
sentences.n: ጵርስፎራ is the Greek prosphora, the offered bread of the Eucharist. አጵርጌ is obscure to me; I leave it as 'apurge (?)', not guessing a meaning. አማኑኤል is Emmanuel (Isaiah 7:14, Matthew 1:23). አክራጦስ is Greek akratos, 'unmixed, pure' (?), as the glossary already hedges. ዘአልቦቱ 'who has not' (ዘ + አልቦ + -ቱ); ቱስሕተ (tusḥətä; ቱ is the 4th-order tu, not ṭu) I take as 'fault, error' (?), related to ስሕተት, but the form is unusual and Dillmann is not at hand. እንተ is the feminine relative; the house entries for እንተ show it after ሥጋ (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ), but it could also agree with the feminine loan ጵርስፎራ (?); ነሥአ 'took' (n-ś-ʾ); እማርያም 'from Mary' (እም-).

sentences.l: who said-to-them to-his-apostles holy: 'Eat my-flesh; and-whoever not-ate my-flesh, there-is-not share with-me and-there-is-not life of-eternity; but-whoever ate my-flesh, even-if he-died, he-will-live for-ever, and-he-partook-of my-flesh and-my-blood and-became my-heir, and-he-says-to-him to-my-father, "You (are) our-father who (is) in-heavens";
sentences.i: who said to His holy apostles: 'Eat my flesh. And whoever does not eat my flesh has no share with me and no eternal life; but whoever eats my flesh, even if he dies, will live for ever, and has shared in my flesh and my blood and become my heir, and says to my Father, "You are our Father who is in the heavens";
sentences.n: This is a free paraphrase of John 6:53-58, with the Lord's Prayer (Matthew 6:9) at the end. ዘይቤሎሙ 'who said to them' (ዘ + ይቤ + -ሎሙ). ብልዑ is the 2mp imperative of በልዐ 'eat'. ወዘሰ 'and whoever' (ወ + ዘ + -ሰ). ኢበልዐ negated perfect; አልቦ 'there is not' is the negative existential. ክፍለ and ሕይወተ are accusatives after አልቦ. እመኒ ሞተ የሐዩ: 'even if he died he will live' (perfect in the if-clause, imperfect in the result). ወተሳተፈ is the tä- form of the lengthened stem (tä-sātäfä, reciprocal type), perfect, 'took part in, shared in'. መዋርስትየ I take as 'my heir' (መዋርስት + -የ), perhaps 'co-heir' (?). ወይብሎ ... አንተ አቡነ: the believer addresses God (all of this is still the Lord's speech, which closes in the next unit); the speaker's 'my father' becomes 'our father' in the quoted prayer. The verbs shift from perfect to imperfect freely in this sentence.

sentences.i: And the Father also answers him (?), saying to him, "You are my son."'
sentences.n: ወአብኒ: አብ 'father' with -ኒ 'also'. ይሰጠዎ is read here as 'he answers him' (?), a 3ms imperfect with -ዎ 'him' (stem ሰጠወ, uncertain without Dillmann); 'gives to him' is the other possible sense. እንዘ ይብሎ 'while he says to him' (conjunction + imperfect). ወልድየ አንተ 'my son (are) you' is a nominal sentence (predicate ወልድየ fronted, subject አንተ), not a vocative. The Father's reply echoes Psalm 2:7 and the baptism voice.

sentences.i: And the crown that is above, that is the prosphora, a likeness of the stone that the Jews sealed upon the tomb.
sentences.n: አክሊል 'crown' here seems to name the upper covering of the arrangement (?); the text identifies it with the prosphora. እንተ መልዕልተ 'which (is) above' (feminine relative + preposition). ኀተምዋ 'they sealed it' (3mp perfect + -ዋ 'her/it'); the stone is feminine in Geʿez (እብን), hence the feminine relative እንተ. The allusion is to the stone and seal on the tomb (Matthew 27:66). The sign ፨ closes the unit.

sentences.i: And when the priest says, 'Send the Holy Spirit; may the Holy Spirit be sent, and may the body of our Lord become perfect' — and when we have received communion, we become sharers in the flesh and blood of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God, and of the Holy Spirit, from now and for ever.
sentences.n: This is the invocation of the Spirit (epiclesis) in the liturgy. ፈኑ is the 2ms imperative of ፈነወ 'send'. ይትፌነው is a Gt jussive, 'let him be sent / let him come' (the shape is odd, so the reading is a little uncertain (?)). መንፈሰ ቅዱሰ: both words are accusative singular (-ä) as object of ፈኑ; the house entries label them construct, but there is no governed noun. ተመጠውነ 'we received' (1cp perfect, Gt of መጠወ 'give over', used for taking communion); ንከውን 'we become' (1cp imperfect); ይከውን ... ፍጹመ 'may it be perfect' takes ፍጹመ as predicate accusative. ሱቱፋነ 'sharers' is a predicate accusative plural. ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር ሕያው: 'son of God the living' (Matthew 16:16). The final phrase እ ፡ ምይእዜ is printed with a separate እ, presumably እም 'from' (?); ምይእዜ 'now'.

sentences.i: and they say, 'Their gods are many,' and they bow down to trees. And they say, chanting (?), as in the word of the prophet Isaiah: 'To half of it you bow down, and with half of it you roast meat and eat';
sentences.n: ተዘሚሮሙ is the gerund (converb) of ዘመረ 'sing', Gt, with -ሙ marking a 3mp subject, and means 'singing/chanting' (?), though the sense here may be 'making a mock-song'; I hedge it. ኀበ ነገረ 'where (is) the word of' (ነገረ is a construct). The quotation is a loose citation of Isaiah 44:15-17 (a man burns half the wood and bows to the rest). The endings -ዲ in ይሰግዲ, ትሰግዲ stand where -ዱ would be expected (a spelling or dialect feature of the text, (?)). The verbs ትሰግዲ, ትጠብሱ, ትበልዑ are 2mp imperfects, and ሰገደ 'bow down' takes ለ- for its object. ለመንፈቁ 'to its half' (ለ- governed by ሰገደ; መንፈቅ 'half' + -ሁ), በመንፈቁ 'with its half'.

sentences.l: These-then (are) those-who cause-to-err-them demons, by-their-evil; and-David also said concerning-them, 'Their-gods of-the-nations (are) demons; and-God indeed made the-heavens; faith(?) and-goodness (are) before-him.'
sentences.i: These, then, are the ones whom demons lead astray by their evil. And David also spoke about them: 'The gods of the nations are demons; but God made the heavens. Faith (?) and goodness are before Him.'
sentences.n: ያስሕትዎሙ is the causative (አስሕተ) 3mp imperfect with -ዎሙ 'them', 'they lead them astray'; the subject አጋንንት 'demons' follows. በእከዮሙ 'by their evil'. The quotation is Psalm 96:5-6 (95:5-6 in the Greek numbering): 'the gods of the nations are demons, but the Lord made the heavens'. ወእግዚኣብሔርሰ: the enclitic -ሰ marks the contrast. አሚን in the psalm line is probably 'faith/trust' (?), but it could be 'truly'; ወሠናይት 'goodness' (ሠናይ + -ት), perhaps 'beauty' as the psalm has 'splendour' (?). ቅድሜሁ 'before him'. አማልክቲሆሙ ለአሕዛብ: the suffix -ሆሙ anticipates the owner, named by ለአሕዛብ (ለ- genitive), so 'their gods, of the nations'. The Geʿez Psalter follows the Greek numbering. The closing ፨ ፨ ፨ ends the chapter.

glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አምሳለ: አምሳል — likeness, image (construct 'likeness of') · accusative 'likenesses, types' after ብዙኀ 'many' (ብዙኀ አምሳለ 'many likenesses')
glossary.አቅርንተ: ቀርን — horns (noun, plural አቅርንት; construct 'horns of')
glossary.አክራጦስ: አክራጦስ — Akraṭos (?) (Greek loan, perhaps 'unmixed, pure', an epithet of Christ; uncertain) (?)
glossary.አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ) · nominative, subject or apposition (ኀተምዋ አይሁድ 'the Jews sealed it'; ዕዉራነ ልብ አይሁድ 'the Jews, blind of heart')
glossary.አጵርጌ: አጵርጌ — apurge (?) (obscure word; meaning unknown, left unguessed) (?)
glossary.ኢበልዐ: በልዐ — he did not eat (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ኢይትመክሑ: ተመክሐ — that they boast not (ኢ- + 3mp jussive, Gt of መክሐ)
glossary.እ: እም — from (?) (preposition; printed as a separate እ: the first part of እምይእዜ 'from now', whose ም has been carried over to the next word) (?)
glossary.እሉኬ: እሉ — these then (demonstrative pronoun pl. + particle -ኬ 'then')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ክፍለ: ክፍል — division of (noun, construct) · accusative, predicate 'a share, sharers' (ትከውኑ ክፍለ ምስሌነ 'you will be sharers with us') · accusative 'a share, portion' after አልቦ (አልቦ ክፍለ ምስሌየ 'has no share with me')
glossary.ወለጣዖት: ጣዖት — and to the idol (ወ- + ለ- + noun, loan word)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወመድኀኒነ: መድኀኒ — and our Saviour (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወሠናይት: ሠናይት — and goodness, beauty (?) (ወ- + noun, fem.) (?)
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወበመንፈቁ: መንፈቅ — and with its half (ወ- + በ- + noun 'half' + -ሁ '3ms its')
glossary.ወተሳተፈ: ተሳተፈ — and he shared, partook (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä- stem, 'be a partner in')
glossary.ወትበልዑ: በልዐ — and you eat (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወንግሩኬ: ነገረ — and tell! (ወ- + 2mp imperative, G, n-g-r, + particle -ኬ 'then, so')
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአብኒ: አብ — and the Father also (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወእግዚኣብሔርሰ: እግዚአብሔር — and God indeed (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ሰ marking contrast, 'but God')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወዘመልዕልተ: መልዕልት — and what is above (ወ- + relative ዘ- + noun used as preposition 'above')
glossary.ወዘሰ: ዘ — and whoever, indeed (ወ- + relative ዘ + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወዘያነብሩ: አንበረ — and which they set, place (ወ- + relative ዘ- + 3mp imperfect, causative, n-b-r)
glossary.ወይሰግዲ: ሰገደ — and they bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, s-g-d, written with final -ዲ)
glossary.ወይብሉ: ብህለ — and they say (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, defective b-h-l)
glossary.ወይብሎ: ብህለ — and he says to him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect ይብል + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ወደምየ: ደም — and my blood (ወ- 'and' + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወፀረ: ፀር — and enemy of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወፈጠሩነ: ፈጠረ — and they created us (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, f-ṭ-r, + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዕዉራነ: ዕዉር — blind ones (noun, plural ዕዉራን, construct 'blind of')
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity') · 'for ever' as an adverb after a noun (ደዌ ዘለዓለም 'sickness for ever')
glossary.ዘበሰማያት: ሰማይ — which (is) in the heavens (ዘ- relative + በ- + plural ሰማያት)
glossary.ዘአልቦቱ: አልቦ — who has not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'there is not' + -ቱ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — who said to them (relative ዘ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ, G, defective b-h-l, + -ሎሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.የሐዩ: ሐይወ — he lives (3ms imperfect, G, ḥ-y-w)
glossary.ያስሕትዎሙ: አስሕተ — they lead them astray (3mp imperfect, causative, s-ḥ-t, + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይሠውዑ: ሠውዐ — they sacrifice, offer (3mp imperfect, G, ś-w-ʿ)
glossary.ይሰግዲ: ሰገደ — they bow down (3mp imperfect, G, s-g-d, written with final -ዲ)
glossary.ይሰጠዎ: ሰጠወ — he answers him (?) (3ms imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; 'gives to him' also possible) (?)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይብልዎሙ: ብህለ — they say to them (3mp imperfect, G, defective b-h-l, + -ልዎሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ይብሎ: ብህለ — he says to him (3ms imperfect ይብል, G, defective verb b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይትፌነው: ተፈነወ — let him be sent (3ms jussive, Gt passive of ፈነወ; the shape is unusual) (?)
glossary.ዲቤሁ: ዲበ — upon him, upon it (preposition, stem ዲቤ- + -ሁ '3ms')
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ጠረጲዛ: ጠረጲዛ — table (noun; loan from Greek trapeza)
glossary.ጵርስፎራ: ጵርስፎራ — prosphora, the offered Eucharistic bread (noun; Greek loan)
glossary.ፍጹመ: ፍጹም — perfectly, completely (adjective as adverbial accusative) · predicate accusative 'perfect' (ኩን ፍጹመ 'be perfect')
glossary.፩፩: አሐዱ — spoken አሐዱ አሐዱ (ʾäḥadu ʾäḥadu) 'one, one', doubled for 'one by one, each one' (numeral, distributive repetition) (?)
glossary.፻፫: ምእት — spoken ምእት ወሠለስቱ (məʾət wä-śälästu) 'one hundred and three' (numeral; chapter number)
